name: IMO MARPOL (International Maritime Organization)
notes: UN shipping regulator and custodian of MARPOL; Annex VI (1997) covers air pollution and emissions from ships incl. the sulphur cap - named in MID card gaps. Convention texts open; commercial codes (IMDG etc.) are paid products; copyright/permission page governs reuse. Evidence: imo.org environment pages read 2026-10-29.
